core_capabilities: Search and filter accommodation results and create a persisted in-app stay booking from validated guest and payment details.

Search, filter, sort, and inspect flights, then configure contact information, ticket flexibility, and extras through a checkout that ends with a transient confirmation rather than a persisted booking.
Filter and select rental cars and create a persisted in-app rental booking with driver, insurance, pickup, drop-off, and payment details.
Choose an attraction date, ticket option, and quantity and create a persisted in-app attraction booking.
Filter airport-transfer vehicles, select one for a route and passenger count, and create a persisted in-app taxi booking.
Filter and compare flight-and-hotel packages and create a persisted in-app package booking with traveler and room details.
Modify guest or date details for a persisted in-app trip, or cancel it, and verify the updated record.
secondary_capabilities: Filter persisted in-app trips by booking status.
Search Help Centre article titles, content, and keywords and inspect the matching answers.
Choose and persist a language and currency display preference without claiming that page content is translated or monetary amounts are converted.
Submit a validated dispute or feedback form and create a persisted in-app record with an identifier, submission status, and timestamp.

Start and resume a persisted property-registration draft containing the property type, basic contact and listing details, and wizard step; the final action clears the draft and does not publish a public listing.
Use the email-code or simulated provider flow to persist an in-app authenticated state, without claiming delivery of a real email code or communication with an external OAuth provider.

app.description: Plan travel by searching and comparing accommodations, flights, cars, attractions, airport taxis, and packages, with persisted in-app booking management for supported products.
app.label: travelhub ad web

nodes.description: Entered details for MinePatch TravelHub Property in London and advanced its hotel registration to the Room setup step.
Filtered London attractions for free cancellation and 4.5+ ratings by lowest price, then opened London Eye availability with Standard and Flexible Entry options.

Sign in through the visible email-verification UI at '/sign-in' and reach the authenticated TravelHub home. Start at /sign-in, type an email address into the email field, submit "Continue with email", then enter a 6-digit verification code into the six single-character code inputs (#code-0 through #code-5); the sixth digit auto-completes sign-in. This app's email verification is a client-side mock that accepts ANY 6-digit code (there is no real inbox and no server-side code check), so use email '[email omitted]' and code '123456'. Confirm success by observing that the sign-in form is gone and the authenticated TravelHub home page ('/') is shown.
Searched the Help Centre for refunds and viewed the answer explaining when a refund should arrive.
TravelHub was set to USD and returned to the home page with the language selector showing its available options.
Submitted a guest dispute about a cancelled reservation and refund status, with confirmation sent to [email omitted].
Opened the account sign-in flow, viewed the Google and email options, and returned to the signed-out homepage.
Completed a British Airways BA28 flight booking from Hong Kong to London with a standard ticket and travel insurance.
A Flight + Hotel package from London to Barcelona at Hotel Arts Barcelona for two adults from 7–14 August 2026 was booked successfully.
Booked a Mercedes S-Class luxury airport taxi from London Heathrow Airport to London Gatwick Airport for 7 August 2026.
A BMW X5 SUV rental at London Heathrow Airport was booked with full protection.
Published a hotel listing with room capacity, amenities, five photos, and pricing details, then returned to the property registration page.
Opened the Help Centre and displayed the available language options.
Cancelled the Avis BMW X5 car rental booking and viewed it with Cancelled status in Manage Trips.
The TravelHub home page was opened and displayed in English.
Updated the Hotel Arts Barcelona booking guest name to Mine Patch Updated and added the special request Late check-in after 9 PM.
The TravelHub display currency was changed from USD to EUR.
Updated the Hotel Arts Barcelona booking dates to August 8–15, 2026.
The upcoming trips view was opened and showed that no trips were found.
